topic: Decide on a coworking space for our startup

scenario.topic: Decide on a coworking space for our startup
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when choosing a coworking space: cost, location, amenities, or vibe?

options.name: BrightHub Coworking Center Midtown
options.upside: Modern design with plenty of natural light and included meeting rooms
options.tradeoff: Slightly higher cost leaves less budget for snacks or extras
options.concern: Some find the open layout noisy during peak hours
options.best_for: teams valuing a bright, professional environment with meeting space

options.name: The Foundry Workspace in Eastside
options.upside: Lower cost leaves budget for team events or equipment
options.tradeoff: Farther from downtown and limited meeting room availability
options.concern: Some feel the industrial decor is less cozy and welcoming
options.best_for: teams prioritizing cost savings over location and amenities

options.name: GreenLeaf Studios near Central Park
options.upside: Close to downtown with eco-friendly design and quiet zones
options.tradeoff: Maxes out budget with fewer meeting rooms than some competitors
options.concern: Limited parking options may inconvenience some team members
options.best_for: teams wanting proximity and a quiet, green workspace

options.name: TechNest Hub in Riverside District
options.upside: High-speed internet and flexible meeting room rentals
options.tradeoff: Pay-per-use meeting rooms can add unpredictable costs
options.concern: Location is less central and public transit options are limited
options.best_for: teams needing fast internet and flexible meeting space despite location

shared_context: Our startup team has exactly 3 members
We have a monthly budget cap of $900 for coworking
We want a space within 10 miles of downtown
We need reliable high-speed internet and some meeting room access

personas.name: Kira
personas.background: Kira values flexible meeting space and fast internet to support dynamic team collaboration.
personas.private_goal: She wants a coworking space with high-speed internet and multiple meeting rooms even if it costs a bit more.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative

personas.name: Quinn
personas.background: Quinn is highly conscientious and agreeable, focused on a quiet, green workspace close to downtown to maximize productivity and team well-being.
personas.private_goal: She prefers a location near downtown with eco-friendly design and quiet zones to foster concentration and morale.
